# amoorion

> Universal tool for administration of chatting and communication platforms: publish, read and reply on many platforms from one CLI, HTTP API or MCP server. Version 0.4.36.

## Docs

- [Documentation, as an index for agents](https://amoorion.readthedocs.io/llms.txt)
- [Agent skill](https://amoorion.readthedocs.io/skills/amoorion/SKILL.md)
